_doc: The range policy (docs/architecture/ADR-0022). never: ids the allocator never hands out. packs: a pack's fixed range per namespace, [first, last]. A shard maintainer overrides this with a file of the same shape (--ranges FILE or UO_DATA_RANGES): its never lists are added, its pack entries replace these. Bodies are fixed too, so packs staged separately never share one; a pack's paperdoll gumps follow its bodies (50000/60000 + body).
